info.title: Pairiquium Integration API
info.description: The HTTP surface a game backend integrates with: minting a matchmaking ticket, and the webhook Pairiquium calls when a match is made. The real-time client protocol is described separately in the AsyncAPI document.

servers.description: Latency-routed to the nearest region. Tickets can still be minted for any active region via `preferredRegion`.

post.summary: Mint a matchmaking ticket for a player
post.description:
Call this from **your backend** after you have authenticated the player. Never call it from a game client: it requires your secret API key. Hand the returned `ticket` and `wsEndpoint` to the client, which connects to `wsEndpoint` with `?ticket=<ticket>`.

Tickets are single-use, expire after 300 seconds, and are locked to one region. Mint a new ticket for every connection attempt, including reconnects.

Requires an API key with the `tickets:create` scope.

400.description: Invalid JSON, failed validation, or `preferredRegion` is not an active region.

401.description: No `X-MaaS-API-Key` header was sent. The body is `{"message": "Unauthorized"}`.

403.description: The API key is not valid (body `{"message": "Forbidden"}`), does not have the `tickets:create` scope (body `{"error": "Forbidden", "message": "..."}`), or the tenant is on the signup waitlist (body `{"error": "..."}`). The body shape depends on which check failed, so rely on the status code.

500.description: Unexpected server error. Safe to retry.

post.description:
Pairiquium sends this to the `NotificationWebhook` URL configured on the game mode when a match is made. Use it to allocate or select a game server, then deliver connection details to the players.

- Respond with a `2xx` status within 5 seconds. Any other status, or a timeout, is treated as a failure and retried.
- Delivery is at-least-once. De-duplicate on the `Pairiquium-Webhook-Id` header (equal to `matchId`).
- Every request is signed. Verify the `Pairiquium-Signature` header before trusting the body: it is `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`, where `v1` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw request body>` keyed with the game mode's webhook signing secret (shown in the dashboard). Compare in constant time and reject timestamps more than 5 minutes from your clock. Game modes created before signing was introduced send no signature until their secret is rolled.

parameters.name: Pairiquium-Signature
parameters.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>">`. Present once the game mode has a signing secret.

parameters.name: Pairiquium-Webhook-Id
parameters.description: Unique ID for this match (the `matchId`). Identical across retries; use it to de-duplicate.

200.description: Acknowledged. Any 2xx status is accepted; the response body is ignored.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-MaaS-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your secret API key. Keep it on your backend; never ship it in a game client.

userId.description: Your identifier for the player. Becomes the participant `UserId` in match webhooks.

attrs.description: Player attributes used by game modes that match on them.

preferredRegion.description: Region to lock the ticket to. Defaults to the region that handled the request.

ticket.description: Single-use, short-lived, region-locked JWT. Pass it to the client.

wsEndpoint.description: WebSocket endpoint the ticket is valid for.

UserId.description: The `userId` supplied when the ticket was generated.

SearchDurationSeconds.description: How long this player was searching before the match was made.

Mmr.description: Present when the game mode matches on MMR.

Ping.description: Measured round-trip time in ms; present when the game mode matches on ping.

PartyId.description: Present when the player queued as part of a party; players sharing a `PartyId` queued together.
